purpose: Freeze a complete label-blind acquisition-coordinate manifest for every source in the public 122,820-row POSS-I S0 cohort using named-plate headers only. The manifest binds each frozen src_id to exact plate/tile lineage, corrected tile pixel coordinates and full-plate pixel coordinates before any large-scale pixel morphology is acquired.

acquisition_coordinate_contract.plate_identity: Frozen public tile_id -> plate_id mapping from the release tile manifest.
acquisition_coordinate_contract.tile_geometry: Same 7x7 pixel-space grid, 60-arcmin tile size, overlap_slices and format_tile_id identity used by B2/C0/C0H.
acquisition_coordinate_contract.astrometric_correction: Same frozen per-plate CRPIX correction table and clean_tan_header_from_full TAN refit used by admitted C0/C0H.
acquisition_coordinate_contract.source_coordinate: Frozen final S0 ra/dec; no source search, nearest-neighbour association or peak recentering.
acquisition_coordinate_contract.full_plate_pixel: tile_pixel + deterministic full-plate section origin for that exact tile.
acquisition_coordinate_contract.pixel_scale: Local corrected-tile projection-plane pixel scale in arcsec/pixel.
acquisition_coordinate_contract.structural_context: Join only already-frozen 2F-A structural_cluster, anomaly_score and structural feature flags by exact src_id. This is morphology-blind context already frozen before C0M.

sharding_contract.assignment: Sort all distinct frozen S0 plate_id values lexicographically and assign plate ordinal i to shard i mod 16. Every source/tile from a plate remains within one shard.
sharding_contract.aggregate_source_union: Must contain exactly 122,820 unique frozen src_id values with zero duplicates, zero omissions and zero extras.
sharding_contract.aggregate_plate_union: Must equal exactly the distinct plate_id set derived from the frozen S0 cohort.
sharding_contract.aggregate_tile_union: Must equal exactly the distinct tile_id set represented by the frozen S0 cohort. Zero-candidate public tiles are not required because they have no source acquisition target.

predeclared_gates.source_binding: 122,820/122,820 unique S0 src_id rows must join one-to-one to the frozen 2F-A structural manifest.
predeclared_gates.plate_binding: Every S0 row must have exactly one frozen plate_id via tile_manifest.
predeclared_gates.header_access: Every distinct plate represented in S0 must yield a valid named POSS-I header/WCS and an ok frozen CRPIX correction row.
predeclared_gates.tile_identity: Every distinct tile_id represented in S0 must regenerate exactly from its named plate 7x7 grid.
predeclared_gates.prediction_coverage: 122,820/122,820 sources must receive finite corrected tile_x0/tile_y0 and fullplate_x0/fullplate_y0 predictions plus finite local_pixel_scale_arcsec.
predeclared_gates.tile_bounds: All predicted corrected tile coordinates must lie within the deterministic trimmed tile footprint with a diagnostic margin reported; do not silently clip or recenter out-of-bounds predictions.
predeclared_gates.shard_integrity: All 16 shard receipts and sidecars must pass hashes, exact deterministic plate assignment and non-overlap before aggregation.
predeclared_gates.pixel_transport: No remote hdu.section, hdu.data or image array materialization is permitted anywhere in C0M.

forbidden_inputs: Blue Book or other human-report labels
external_label_firewall.reason: C0M freezes where to read pixels before any morphology acquisition. External labels remain unavailable until the later full morphology feature manifest and morphology clusters are themselves frozen.
